sections.title: Tokens & specs
sections.notes: The selector switches among the common and six element/color token sets; the available primary/secondary/tertiary sets and compatible FAB colors are captured by fab-menu-color-set-availability and pair-primary-menu-colors-with-primary-or.

sections.title: Anatomy
sections.notes: The diagram names the close button and menu item; item count is governed by include-2-6-closely-related-actions-under-one and label requirements by keep-a-text-label-on-every-menu.

sections.title: Color
sections.notes: The source enumerates twelve color roles but the mapping of roles to close button and menu item depends on the uninspected color diagram; element-specific pairings remain unresolved.

sections.title: States
sections.notes: This section contains only the generic definition of interaction states; close-button and menu-item state requirements are recorded in fab-menu-close-button-states and fab-menu-item-states.

sections.title: Menu item
sections.notes: The section is descriptive or repeats guidance captured by the component checks; it adds no independently assessable instruction.

sections.title: Measurements
sections.notes: The explicit 56dp close-button size, compact 16dp margins, top-trailing anchor and larger-FAB clearance rule are captured by fab-menu-close-button-and-web-gap, fab-menu-compact-anchor-and-margins and fab-menu-larger-anchor-clearance. Image-only size callouts, including the medium-FAB 40dp bottom margin, remain uninspected.
